title: Noore Nigahe sarwar kadyal jawan Akbar
body:
noore nigahe sarwar kadiyal jawan akber
zainab ke dil ki dharas laila ki jaan akber
ghurbat ko shaahe dee'n ki samjhe bhala koi kya
maanga jawa'n ne pani sheh ne kaha aye beta
<<DIVIDER>>
meri zubaa'n pe rakhdo apni zubaan akber
kar daala deen e haq pa qurbaan zindagi ko
dedi jawani apni deen e mohammadi ko
yaad aati hai tumhari sunkar azaan akber
<<DIVIDER>>
seene ko sheh ne dekha haatou'n ko jab hatakar
chilla ke bole haaye kya dard ka hai manzar
barchhi ka phal jigar ke hai darmiyaan akber
dil se laga ke dil ko uthe hussain jis dam
<<DIVIDER>>
li mout ki ek hichki kadiyal jawa'n ne us dam
bole hussain nikli hai meri jaan akber
ye bekasi jaha'n me dekhi nahi kisi ki
lasha jawa'n pisar ka aur baap ki zaeefi
<<DIVIDER>>
kya sakht shaahe dee'n ka hai imtehaan akber
goudi me sar ko rakh ke karti hai bain laila
aye laal mere bachche kaise jiye ye dukhiya
veeran kargaye tum mera makaan akber
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho faseeh ab to dil gham se roraha hai
ham shakl e mustafa ka matam jo ho rha hai
ghamgeen hai fizaye'n aur asmaan akber
